name: Create custom prompt topic
description: Create custom prompt topic Creates a DLP custom prompt topic entry. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/custom_prompt_topics
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/custom_prompt_topics
Creates a DLP custom prompt topic entry.
Required: account_id (path); body (body) — A new custom prompt topic to create.

name: Delete custom prompt topic
description: Delete custom prompt topic Deletes a DLP custom prompt topic entry. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/custom_prompt_topics/{entry_id}

name: Get custom prompt topic
description: Get custom prompt topic Fetches a DLP custom prompt topic entry by ID. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/custom_prompt_topics/{entry_id}

name: List custom prompt topics
description: List custom prompt topics Lists all DLP custom prompt topic entries in an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/custom_prompt_topics
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/custom_prompt_topics
Lists all DLP custom prompt topic entries in an account.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Update custom prompt topic
description: Update custom prompt topic Updates a DLP custom prompt topic entry. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/custom_prompt_topics/{entry_id}
